svg.title: Efficient Frontier (Illustrative) / 有效前沿示意图
svg.desc: Illustrative portfolio risk-return space for a sample portfolio set: volatility on the horizontal axis and expected return on the vertical axis, both indicative only. The chart shows candidate portfolios, the efficient frontier, the inefficient boundary, the maximum Sharpe portfolio, and the current portfolio; it is a schematic illustration of the output shape, not a live market calculation. / 示意图，非实时市场数据。
